note_en: 一…就… means "as soon as … then …": the second action follows the first immediately, almost automatically. 这种云一出现，两天之内就要起大风 "as soon as clouds like these appear, a gale will blow within two days"; 他一听说台风要来，就请了假 "the moment he heard the typhoon was coming, he took leave." 一 goes before the first verb and 就 before the second, and the two halves can have different subjects: 船一靠岸，加工厂的人就迎了上来 "the moment the boat docked, the people from the processing plant came to meet it."
